items.claim: Your shot hits your own fence, then flies over the net. The rally goes on.
items.question: Can you play the ball off your own fence?
items.fact_source: FIP Reglamento de Juego, Regla 13.1.l (own glass allowed, own fence = point lost)
items.caption:
Your own back glass is your friend. But what about the fence above it? 🤔

Most club players get this one wrong.

items.claim: Your serve clips the net, lands in the box, then hits the fence. You serve again.
items.question: When do you replay a net serve?
items.fact_source: FIP Reglamento de Juego, Regla 9.1.a + 7.1.e (net solo si no toca la malla antes del segundo bote)
items.caption:
Net cord on the serve – everyone knows you just serve again. Right? 🤔

Not always. One detail changes everything.
